motivation: prompt labels missing; timestamps permit call-arrival labels without assigning missing prompt as zero
source: independently verified complete call counts from fixed Copilot June5-7 session partitions
target: maximum recorded calls per5min from origin through ready bin; prepare5/10/30min
split: trainJune5 complete targets; validationJune6 complete targets; testJune7 complete targets
models: three HGBq90, same fixed v2 hyperparameters, no hyperparameter search
features: eleven prior call-count/time features normalized by preceding hour mean, minimum mean1call
selection: lowest validation pinball baseline before computing test scores; all baseline test losses preserved
feedback: none; no later-day refit or residual correction
gate: test pinball reduction>=5% versus validation-selected baseline; empirical coverage85..95%
limits: call counts include recorded unsuccessful attempts
not an independent multi-service or long-duration confirmation
calls do not encode token complexity or GPU cost
token_transfer_no_go: unchanged; this is a different label and new service-specific models
